verses.en: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
verses.pt: Entretanto, o menino Samuel servia ao Senhor perante Eli. E a palavra de Senhor era muito rara naqueles dias; as visões não eram freqüentes.
verses.en_web: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was precious in those days. There were not many visions, then.
verses.en_bbe: Now the young Samuel was the servant of the Lord before Eli. In those days the Lord kept his word secret from men; there was no open vision.

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;
verses.pt: Sucedeu naquele tempo que, estando Eli deitado ne seu lugar (ora, os seus olhos começavam já a escurecer, de modo que não podia ver),
verses.en_web: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),
verses.en_bbe: And at that time, when Eli was resting in his place, (now his eyes were becoming clouded so that he was not able to see,)

verses.en: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;
verses.pt: e ainda não se havendo apagado a lâmpada de Deus, e estando Samuel também deitado no templo do Senhor, onde estava a arca de Deus,
verses.en_web: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple, where God’s ark was;
verses.en_bbe: And the light of God was still burning, while Samuel was sleeping in the Temple of the Lord where the ark of God was,

verses.en: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.
verses.pt: o Senhor chamou: Samuel! Samuel! Ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: Yahweh called Samuel; and he said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: The voice of the Lord said Samuel's name; and he said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.
verses.pt: E correndo a Eli, disse-lhe: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Mas ele disse: Eu não te chamei; torna a deitar-te. E ele foi e se deitou.
verses.en_web: He ran to Eli, and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.
verses.en_bbe: And running to Eli he said, Here am I, for you said my name. And Eli said, I did not say your name; go to your rest again. So he went back to his bed.

verses.en: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
verses.pt: Tornou o Senhor a chamar: Samuel! E Samuel se levantou, foi a Eli e disse: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Mas ele disse: Eu não te chamei, filho meu; torna a deitar-te.
verses.en_web: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”
verses.en_bbe: And again the Lord said, Samuel. And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, Here am I; for you certainly said my name. But he said in answer, I said nothing, my son; go to your rest again.

verses.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.
verses.pt: Ora, Samuel ainda não conhecia ao Senhor, e a palavra de Senhor ainda não lhe tinha sido revelada.
verses.en_web: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.
verses.en_bbe: Now at that time Samuel had no knowledge of the Lord, and the revelation of the word of the Lord had not come to him.

verses.en: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.
verses.pt: O Senhor, pois, tornou a chamar a Samuel pela terceira vez. E ele, levantando-se, foi a Eli e disse: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Então entendeu Eli que o Senhor chamava o menino.
verses.en_web: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli, and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.
verses.en_bbe: And for the third time the Lord said Samuel's name. And he got up and went to Eli and said, Here am I; for you certainly said my name. Then it was clear to Eli that the voice which had said the child's name was the Lord's.

verses.en: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.pt: Pelo que Eli disse a Samuel: Vai deitar-te, e há de ser que, se te chamar, dirás: Fala, Senhor, porque o teu servo ouve. Foi, pois, Samuel e deitou-se no seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.en_bbe: So Eli said to Samuel, Go back: and if the voice comes again, let your answer be, Say on, Lord; for the ears of your servant are open. So Samuel went back to his bed.

verses.en: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
verses.pt: Depois veio o Senhor, parou e chamou como das outras vezes: Samuel! Samuel! Ao que respondeu Samuel: Fala, porque o teu servo ouve.
verses.en_web: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord came and said as before, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel made answer, Say on, Lord; for the ears of your servant are open.

verses.en: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Samuel: Eis que vou fazer uma coisa em Israel, a qual fará tinir ambos os ouvidos a todo o que a ouvir.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Samuel, See, I will do a thing in Israel at which the ears of everyone hearing of it will be burning.

verses.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.
verses.pt: Naquele mesmo dia cumprirei contra Eli, de princípio a fim, tudo quanto tenho falado a respeito da sua casa.
verses.en_web: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
verses.en_bbe: In that day I will do to Eli everything which I have said about his family, from first to last.

verses.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.
verses.pt: Porque já lhe fiz: saber que hei de julgar a sua casa para sempre, por causa da iniqüidade de que ele bem sabia, pois os seus filhos blasfemavam a Deus, e ele não os repreendeu.
verses.en_web: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever, for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to say to him that I will send punishment on his family for ever, for the sin which he had knowledge of; because his sons have been cursing God and he had no control over them.

verses.en: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.
verses.pt: Portanto, jurei à casa de Eli que nunca jamais será expiada a sua iniqüidade, nem com sacrifícios, nem com ofertas.
verses.en_web: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”
verses.en_bbe: So I have made an oath to the family of Eli that no offering of meat or of meal which they may make will ever take away the sin of his family.

verses.en: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.
verses.pt: Samuel ficou deitado até pela manhã, e então abriu as portas da casa do Senhor; Samuel, porém, temia relatar essa visão a Eli.
verses.en_web: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel kept where he was, not moving till the time came for opening the doors of the house of God in the morning. And fear kept him from giving Eli an account of his vision.

verses.en: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.
verses.pt: Mas chamou Eli a Samuel, e disse: Samuel, meu filho! Ao que este respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Eli said, Samuel, my son. And Samuel answering said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, What is the thing that the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.
verses.pt: Eli perguntou-lhe: Que te falou o Senhor? peço-te que não mo encubras; assim Deus te faça, e outro tanto, se me encobrires alguma coisa de tudo o que te falou.
verses.en_web: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, What did the Lord say to you? Do not keep it from me: may God's punishment be on you if you keep from me anything he said to you.

verses.en: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.
verses.pt: Samuel, pois, relatou-lhe tudo, e nada lhe encobriu. Então disse Eli: Ele é o Senhor, faça o que bem parecer aos seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel gave him an account of everything, keeping nothing back. And he said, It is the Lord; let him do what seems good to him.

verses.en: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
verses.pt: Samuel crescia, e o Senhor era com ele e não deixou nenhuma de todas as suas palavras cair em terra.
verses.en_web: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him, and let none of his words fall to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel became older, and the Lord was with him and let not one of his words be without effect.

verses.en: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
verses.pt: E todo o Israel, desde Dã até Berseba, conheceu que Samuel estava confirmado como profeta do Senhor.
verses.en_web: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And it was clear to all Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba that Samuel had been made a prophet of the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
verses.pt: E voltou o Senhor a aparecer em Siló; porquanto o Senhor se manifestava a Samuel em Siló pela sua palavra. E chegava a palavra de Samuel a todo o Israel.
verses.en_web: Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was seen again in Shiloh; for the Lord gave to Samuel in Shiloh the revelation of his word.
